spots.text: WELL JUMPED. THE WAY BACK IS THE SAME, ONLY BACKWARDS.
THE HIGHEST SHELF. PLEASE RETURN BOOKS TO THE FLOOR, EVENTUALLY.

secrets.name: The Top of the Tallest Case
secrets.text: No plank reaches it; the ladder is round the back. On top, far above everything, an armchair, a lamp and a stack of books someone carried up one at a time.

meta.label: The Hanging Library
meta.blurb: The bookcases here hang from the ceiling on chains, at every height, a long way above the floor. Planks run between them. The cases creak when you step onto them, but only a little.
